outer.color_note: Exterior is a fiberglass housing over a steel magnet shield; removable top cryostat cover; CAN module bay attached to the side. Separate electronics cabinet 67 x 70 x 100 cm (~70 kg) and Cryomech helium compressor 69 x 50 x 62 cm (~134 kg).

stages.name: Pulse tube first stage / main radiation shield
stages.quote: The first stage typically runs at ~ 45 K, while the second stage typically runs at ~ 4.2 K.

stages.name: Pulse tube second stage / 4 K Plate (thermosiphon from ~150 cc LHe bucket; magnet conduction-cooled from it)
stages.quote: The 4 K Plate is cooled by contact with approximately 150 cc of liquid helium in the bottom of the bucket.

stages.name: Sample chamber isothermal region / puck block (base)
stages.quote: 1.8 to 400 K @ 60Hz; 1.85 to 400 K @ 50Hz (Continuous Low Temperature Control and Temperature Sweep modes)

stages.name: Cryopump cold surfaces (first stage)
stages.quote: cold metal surfaces at about 70 K and charcoal cooled to about 4 K by the cryocooler system in the cryostat

sample_space.shape: vertical cylindrical sample chamber (2.5 cm clear bore) inside the 14 T solenoid bore; 12-pin keyed puck connector at the bottom; field centre 4.05 cm above puck surface
sample_space.description: Open-architecture vertical sample chamber; a 2.3 cm diameter gold-plated copper puck plugs into a 12-pin connector at the chamber bottom. ETO puck, VSM puck + linear motor, or heat-capacity puck (3 mm x 3 mm platform) are installed one at a time. Magnet centre 4 cm above puck surface; 14 T uniformity +/-0.1% over 5.5 cm on axis.

wiring.from: gray Lemo connector / JQP-8 D-shell at top of chamber (room temperature)
wiring.to: 12-pin puck connector at bottom of sample chamber (3 channels x I+/I-/V+/V-)
wiring.quote: These solder pads are connected to a set of 12 sockets on the base of the puck, which contact pins in the bottom of the sample chamber.
The connections labeled "Spare" are not wired to anything, but could be used to feed custom wires into the annulus.

wiring.to: first-stage (shield), second-stage (4 K Plate) and block thermometers
wiring.quote: On the outside of the sample chamber, the block thermometer is tightly coupled to the metal of the puck interface.

wiring.to: first-stage heater (main radiation shield) and second-stage heater (4 K Plate)
wiring.quote: When the system is cold, the first stage heater is off, and the second stage heater is used to control the second stage thermometer at 4.2 K.

moving_parts.quote: The system uses a single, two-stage pulse tube cryocooler for both the superconducting magnet and the temperature control system
All DynaCool systems include a cryocooler system, which consists of a cold head and a compressor manufactured by Cryomech, Inc.
Circulation Pump: This is a sealed scroll pump that is used for circulating helium past the sample chamber for cooling the sample.

moving_parts.rate: 0 to 5000 sccm helium through the cooling annulus
moving_parts.quote: The mass flow controller controls the main flow rate from 0 to 5000 sccm.

notes: Vertical cryogen-free PPMS: a single Cryomech two-stage pulse tube sits in helium gas in a 'bucket' tank (not vacuum-mounted); first stage ~45 K cools the main and annulus radiation shields and cryopump stage 1; the second stage condenses He onto a ~150 cc LHe pool that cools the 4 K Plate by thermosiphon; the switch-less 14 T NbTi solenoid is conduction-cooled by solid contact to the 4 K Plate and produces a vertical (longitudinal) field at 120 A full field. The sample chamber (2.5 cm clear bore) runs down the magnet bore; 4.2 K helium from the bucket passes a counter-flow heat exchanger and mass-flow controller (0-5000 sccm) into the cooling annulus around the chamber and returns via the circulation scroll pump (5-50 Torr return, 500-800 Torr outlet), giving 1.8-400 K at the puck. The puck (2.3 cm Cu, Au plated) plugs into the 12-pin keyed connector at the chamber bottom; the block thermometer is clamped to the puck interface outside the chamber. Magnet centre 4.05 cm above puck surface; 14 T uniformity +/-0.1% over 5.5 cm on axis. Options modelled: ETO (2 channels), VSM (linear transport motor on the top KF flange, 6.3 mm coil bore, 9 mm coil separation, 40 Hz x 2 mm) and Heat Capacity (3 x 3 mm platform, puck microcalorimeter in high vacuum via the integrated cryopump). No optical windows in this configuration (magneto-optic FOSH option not installed). Outer dimensions are D x W x H for cryostat plus can rack; the 67x70x100 cm electronics cabinet and 69x50x62 cm compressor stand apart. 14 T startup 40 h typical; puck 300 K to 1.9 K in under 40 min.
